render_protocol.reference: full source OBJ at 1280x720, 4x MSAA, linear 2x2 box resolve to 640x360
render_protocol.lighting: fixed diffuse material and camera light from the frozen placement control
render_protocol.equal_face_budget: ManyMesh, QEM, and meshoptimizer cuts share each asset's exact pre-screened 49%-51% face count

exploratory: LPIPS SqueezeNet v0.1 on replicated grayscale 8-bit sRGB
unavailable: coverage MAE from the current scorer

decision_rule.familywise_interval: two-sided 95% max-|t| cluster bootstrap over 25 source-family groups, 200000 draws, seed 20261125, shared resamples over the 16 primary metric/control/mode endpoints
decision_rule.primary_pass: Under 4x MSAA, the simultaneous lower bound for LDR-FLIP improvement must exceed the frozen practical margin against both QEM and meshoptimizer.

qem_preserve_border.derivation: 50% of the 21-model development-cohort ManyMesh-minus-control mean gap under 4x MSAA

meshoptimizer_lock_border.derivation: 50% of the 21-model development-cohort ManyMesh-minus-control mean gap under 4x MSAA

decision_rule.guardrail_pass: Under 4x MSAA, no simultaneous interval may show a PSNR, SSIM, or silhouette-XOR regression against either control; report native-mode effects as secondary.
decision_rule.integrity_pass: All 30 assets remain in the report; any missing render, topology failure, boundary change, or face-count mismatch is reported and cannot be silently excluded.
decision_rule.stop: Reject this method configuration if the primary margin is missed, a guardrail regression is supported, or any topology/boundary gate fails. Do not tune and rescore this confirmation cohort.

scope_limits: This is equal-face desktop image-quality evidence, not equal-time evidence.
The protocol compares native and 4x MSAA; it does not establish superiority over SMAA or an upscaler.
Per-asset fitting with disjoint views tests the frozen procedure across these assets; it is not cross-asset neural-model generalization.
The final candidate method/configuration is not frozen yet; this manifest deliberately cannot be consumed by the current score runner.
